Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm caramel complexion, late 30s goddess, siren bust hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, blunt bob rose pink hair — wearing a skin-tight micro school blazer set, a cropped sleeveless blazer-style top of ultra-thin matte navy scuba crepe with gold-trimmed lapels, a small gold crest patch on the left of her chest and a slim navy-and-gold striped tie at her throat, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to the cropped hem and the two sides of the scuba crepe fully covering her bust, ending right under her bust with her whole midriff and stomach bare, and an ultra-micro wrap skirt of ultra-thin matte light-grey scuba crepe tied in a small bow at her hip, the wrap opening in a slit up the side to her hip bone, sitting at the top of her hip bones with the hem ending a hand-width below her hip bones. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small mole near her collarbone and very fine pale hair on her forearms catching the light. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin scuba crepe molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the gold-trimmed lapels, the small gold crest and the striped tie crisp against the navy, the clean edges of the wrap skirt and its bow, a smooth pebbled crepe texture and fine stretch lines. Pose: standing tall facing the camera straight on, arms relaxed at her sides, weight even on both feet, her legs fully in view — most extreme siren bust hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy navy leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in navy lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large statement drop earrings of blackened iron and polished gold as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Latina woman with high cheekbones, large dark eyes and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: bright pastel pink and yellow eyeshadow, thick lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, small star and heart shapes painted on the cheeks only, glossy candy-pink lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows medium body oil, moderate skin glistening, healthy oiled appearance.

Background: golden sand dunes under a clear sky with a smooth flat sand foreground and a standard-height wooden gate frame standing at her side, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
